paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter with spin-based amplifiers
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (dimensional axion-nucleon coupling, not dimensionless)
notes: Spin-based amplifier (hyperpolarized 129Xe pre-amplifier + 87Rb magnetometer) searching for ALP-nucleon coupling over mass range 8.3 feV to 744 feV. The paper reports g_aNN in units of GeV^-1 (a dimensional coupling, gaNN = C/f_a type), NOT the dimensionless g_an convention. The best limit quoted in text: 2.9e-9 GeV^-1 at 67.5 feV (5h data), and 3.5e-9 GeV^-1 at 82.05 feV. Only a few explicit numerical values are given in text; the full exclusion curve (Fig 4b) is not tabulated. I emitted values in the paper's GeV^-1 convention (raw axis values), not converted to dimensionless g_an. Endpoints at mass edges (8.3 and 744 feV) approximate ~few×10^-5 GeV^-1 from the plot. Confidence reduced because coupling convention differs from standard dimensionless g_an and exact curve values are approximate. 129Xe is neutron-sensitive, consistent with AxionNeutron hint.
